intro.p1: Rectio trademarks are invaluable assets that represent customer trust and goodwill in the brand.
intro.p2: Rectio has the exclusive right to use — and authorize the use of — these names, logos, and other signifiers that distinguish its goods, services, and business activities.

sections.title: General Guidelines
sections.intro: These guidelines clarify proper usage of Rectio's trademarks. Rectio reserves the right to take any action (including changing these guidelines) to protect its intellectual property if doing so becomes necessary. Some of Rectio's trademarks, including Rectio's logos, may only be used with Rectio's prior written permission.

items.text: Display Rectio's trademarks in any context that falsely suggests a relationship between:
sub: Rectio and another entity;
Another entity and Rectio's goods, services, or commercial activities; or
Rectio and the goods, services, commercial activities, views, or opinions of another entity.

items.text: Use Rectio's trademarks in a way that implies an affiliation, connection, association, sponsorship, approval, certification, or endorsement, where there is no such relationship.
Use Rectio's trademarks except in a manner that is less prominent than your own trade name or trademarks.
Use any Rectio trademarks in modified forms, including uses that:
sub: Translate or transliterate words in the trademarks;
Substitute images for words or other descriptions;
Combine the trademarks with your name or your marks;
Add any words, symbols, numbers, spaces, punctuation, devices, designs, images, or other matter to any trademarks;
Abbreviate or delete any words, symbols, numbers, spaces, punctuation, devices, designs, images, or other matter from any trademarks;
Make singular words plural or plural words singular;
Insert the trademarks into a tagline or slogan; or
Misspell words within the trademarks.

items.text: Use Rectio's trademarks within or as a component of:
sub: A domain name, subdomain, top-level domain name, or URL;
An email address;
A telephone number;
An app name or software title;
A trade name, business name, fictitious or assumed name, or company name;
An account name, handle, or profile name on any service;
The name of any product, service, or other commercial activity;
The name of any fan group, user group, technology community, or any other organisation; or
The title of any book, film, magazine, website, interactive media, or other expressive content.

items.text: Display Rectio's trademarks except in a positive manner and don't use the trademarks to depict or refer to Rectio or any third party, their products, their services, or their commercial activities in a negative way.

Associate Rectio's trademarks with — or use them in proximity to — any content or activities that are vulgar, obscene, profane, indecent, sexually explicit, immoral, scandalous, defamatory, disparaging or otherwise objectionable.
Use any trademarks or other designations that are confusingly similar to any trademarks that Rectio owns.

sections.title: Wordmarks
sections.intro: Some Rectio trademarks consist of only words and don't feature any particular stylisation, such as a specific font, typeface, or color (collectively "Word Marks" and each a "Word Mark").

items.text: Rectio's Word Marks may be used with Rectio's prior written consent and in compliance with these Guidelines to the extent that such use is not likely confusing and is needed to truthfully convey information, such as:
sub: Indicating the location of an independent business or event within or nearby a Rectio location;
Indicating that a product, service, or solution is interoperable or compatible with a product, service, or solution offered by Rectio;
Accurately and directly referring to Rectio, its businesses, and their products, services, or commercial activities; or
In the titles of news publications and other factual content about Rectio, its businesses, and their products, services, or commercial activities.

items.text: Use Rectio's Word Marks in the context of other text, such as within advertising copy, unless they are shown in a manner that differentiates them from that text by showing the Word Marks in:
sub: Title Case (i.e. capitalising the first letter in each word);
ALL CAPITAL CASE;
Bold Font;
Underlined Font;
Italic Font; or
Some other visually distinct style.

items.text: Only use Rectio Word Marks in text as adjectives accompanied by an appropriate generic noun that refers to the relevant product or service, except when it is appropriate to use a Word Mark as a noun to refer to the company itself.
Use any Rectio trademark as a verb, adverb, or in a manner that suggests they have a common, descriptive, or generic meaning.

sections.title: Logos & Designs
sections.intro: Some Rectio trademarks feature stylization (including a particular font, typeface, or color) or include a device, design, or other image (all collectively “Logos” and each a “Logo”). Rectio may own both trademark rights and copyright rights in its Logos. These Logos may only be used subject to the following guidelines.

items.text: Use Rectio's Logos without Rectio's prior written consent.
Use the Logos on a background color into which they blend, in whole or in part.
Use the Logos within enclosing text or in the middle of a phrase or sentence.

Modify, distort, rotate, animate, or alter Rectio's Logos in any manner and only use the Logos in the form, orientation, and colors supplied by Rectio. You may change the overall size of the Logos, provided that all proportions are maintained.
Incorporate Rectio's Logos into any texture, repeating pattern, or motif.
Use Rectio's Logos, including without limitation its Spark Design, as a letter or as punctuation in any word or phrase.
Display Rectio's Logos in a manner that overlaps the Logo with any shapes, images, photographs, or other trademarks.

sections.title: Trademark & Copyright Notices and Legends
sections.intro: Always use a notice of trademark (the "TM" symbol), notice of service mark (the "SM" symbol), or the notice of registration (the encircled "R" symbol), as each may be appropriate, with the first or most prominent use of each Rectio trademark.

items.text: Use a notice of registration (the encircled "R" symbol) with a trademark that is not registered with the relevant trademark office or one that is not registered in connection with the goods or services at issue.
Use a notice of service mark (the "SM" symbol) with a trademark where the use in question does not relate to services.

Use any trademark notices with Rectio trademarks intended for an audience outside of the country of registration, distributed through a website or publication originating outside that country, or displayed in a manner that is not consistent with local law.
Always include a footnote stating that any Rectio trademarks you use, listed in alphabetical order, are "trademarks of Rectio Inc. and its affiliates" or include that information in another notice.
Always include a footnote stating that any Rectio Logos are "© 2xxx Rectio Inc." (where the "2xxx" year is as may be indicated by Rectio) or include that information in another notice.

sections.title: Vendor Advertising
sections.intro: Rectio considers requests to use certain Logos as “vendor tags,” which relate to the availability of products or services from Rectio, in third party advertisements through its Vendor Tagged Advertising process. The details of this process are explained in the “Vendor advertising” section of this guide.

items.text: Use any Rectio Logos in advertisements without prior written approval.

sections.title: Search Placement & Content Targeting
sections.intro: Rectio considers requests to use its trademarks in connection with the Google AdWords advertising service, or in connection with any other search placement, content targeting, or other advertising placement services, through its Vendor Tagged Advertising process. The details of this process are explained in the “Vendor advertising” section of this guide.

items.text: Use any Rectio trademarks in any search placement, content targeting, or other advertising placement services without prior written approval.

sections.title: Requesting Permission To Use
sections.intro: Rectio considers requests to use its trademarks in connection with the Google AdWords advertising service, or in connection with any other search placement, content targeting, or other advertising placement services, through its Vendor Tagged Advertising process. The details of this process are explained in the “Vendor advertising” section of this guide.

items.text: Requests to use Rectio trademarks in a manner that is not addressed by this form should be directed to an appropriate Rectio business contact.
